31259-the-boy-with-the-u-s-life-savers.title: The Boy With The U S Life Savers
31259-the-boy-with-the-u-s-life-savers.creator: Unknown
31259-the-boy-with-the-u-s-life-savers.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Jumping up so suddenly that the checker-board went in one direction, the table in another, while the checkers rolled to every corner of the little volunteer life-saving station house, Eric Swift made a leap for the door. Quick as he was to reach the boat, he was none too soon, for the coxswain and two other men were tumbling over the gunwale at the same time.

arxiv-2110-02013.title: Two Disjoint Alternating Paths in Bipartite Graphs
arxiv-2110-02013.creator: Archontia C. Giannopoulou – National and Kapodistrian University of Athens archontia.giannopoulou@gmail.com Sebastian Wiederrecht – LIRMM, University of Montpellier sebastian.wiederrecht@gmail.com
arxiv-2110-02013.description: Abstract A bipartite graph B B is called a brace if it is connected and every matching of size at most two in B B is contained in some perfect matching of B B and A cycle C C in B B is called conformal if B − V ⁡ ( C ) B-V(C) has a perfect matching.

arxiv-2202-03690.title: Probing a dissipative phase transition with a trapped ion through reservoir engineering
arxiv-2202-03690.creator: M.-L. Cai 1 , Z.-D. Liu ∗1 , Y. Jiang ∗1 , Y.-K. Wu 1 , Q.-X. Mei 1 , W.-D. Zhao 1 , L. He 1 , X. Zhang 2,1 , Z.-C. Zhou 1,3 , L.-M. Duan 1
arxiv-2202-03690.description: Abstract Dissipation is often considered as a detrimental effect in quantum systems for unitary quantum operations. However, it has been shown that suitable dissipation can be useful resources both in quantum information and quantum simulation. Here, we propose and experimentally simulate a dissipative phase transition (DPT) model using a single trapped ion with an engineered reservoir.

arxiv-2301-05283.title: Integrable systems with linear periodic integral for the Lie algebra e ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{e}(3)
arxiv-2301-05283.creator: I. K. Kozlov, and, A. A. Oshemkov
arxiv-2301-05283.description: Abstract Integrable systems with a linear periodic integral for the Lie algebra e ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{e}(3) are considered. One investigates singulariries of the Liouville foliation, bifurcation diagram of the momentum mapping, transformations of Liouville tori, topology of isoenergy surfaces and other topological properties of such systems.

arxiv-2401-14884.title: P3LS: Partial Least Squares under Privacy Preservation Journal: Journal of Process Control
arxiv-2401-14884.creator: Nguyen Duy Du, Ramin Nikzad-Langerodi
arxiv-2401-14884.description: Abstract Modern manufacturing value chains require intelligent orchestration of processes across company borders in order to maximize profits while fostering social and environmental sustainability. However, the implementation of integrated, systems-level approaches for data-informed decision-making along value chains is currently hampered by privacy concerns associated with cross-organizational data exchange and integration.

arxiv-2402-18560.title: Lossy anharmonic polaritons under periodic driving
arxiv-2402-18560.creator: Maicol A. Ochoa
arxiv-2402-18560.description: Abstract We report on the anharmonic signatures in dissipative polaritons’ stationary energy distribution and thermodynamics under external periodic driving. First, we introduce a dynamic model for the dissipative anharmonic Jaynes-Cummings polariton with a generic time-periodic interaction representing modulations of the polariton’s energy due to an external force or field.

arxiv-2411-03858.title: On the Global Solution and Invariance of nonlinear Constrained Modified Swift-Hohenberg Equation on Hilbert Manifold
arxiv-2411-03858.creator: Saeed Ahmed, Javed Hussain
arxiv-2411-03858.description: Abstract . In this paper, we are interested in proving the existence and uniqueness of the local, local maximal, and global solutions of the equation projected on the Hilbert manifold. Furthermore, we show that, for any given initial data in the Hilbert manifold ℳ \mathcal{M} , the solution to this equation is also in the Hilbert manifold ℳ \mathcal{M} .

arxiv-2504-17687.title: The Igusa zeta function of restricted power series over ℚ p \mathbb{Q}_{p}
arxiv-2504-17687.creator: Leonie Dausy
arxiv-2504-17687.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Leonie Dausy. In this article, we ask whether the Igusa zeta function of a restricted power series over ℚ p \mathbb{Q}_{p} can be determined solely from the terms of degree at most D D . That is, we ask whether the truncated polynomial f D f_{D} , consisting of all terms of f f of degree ≤ D \leq D , yields the same Igusa zeta function as f f for sufficiently large D D .

arxiv-2506-15135.title: Towards Bug-Free Distributed Go Programs
arxiv-2506-15135.creator: Koo Zhengqun
arxiv-2506-15135.description: Abstract B.Comp. Dissertation Department of Computer Science School of Computing National University of Singapore (NUS) Project ID: H018740 Project Supervisor: Prof Chin Wei Ngan Project Co-Supervisor: Dr Andreea Costea Deliverables: Report: 1 Volume 1 Abstract Programmers of distributed systems need to reason about concurrency to avoid races. However, reasoning about concurrency is difficult, and unexpected races show up as bugs.

arxiv-2507-10087.title: Foundation Model Driven Robotics: A Comprehensive Review
arxiv-2507-10087.creator: Muhammad Tayyab Khan † , Ammar Waheed † *
arxiv-2507-10087.description: Abstract The rapid emergence of foundation models, particularly Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs), has introduced a transformative paradigm in robotics. These models offer powerful capabilities in semantic understanding, high-level reasoning, and cross-modal generalization, enabling significant advances in perception, planning, control, and human-robot interaction.

arxiv-2605-02661.title: AcademiClaw: When Students Set Challenges for AI Agents

pmc-11557763.title: Effect of an Exercise Intervention Based on General Adaptation Syndrome Model on Psychological Experience in Community-Dwelling Elderly
pmc-11557763.creator: Liping Dai, Bingjin Su, Kun Ma
pmc-11557763.description: Background:With the intensification of population aging globally, the mental health of the elderly is not only related to their personal well-being but also directly affects family harmony and social stability. However, few studies have been conducted on interventions for mental health issues in the elderly.

pmc-11696659.title: Telomere-based risk models for the early diagnosis of lung cancer
pmc-11696659.creator: Sonia Molina-Pinelo, Irene Ferrer Sánchez, Pilar Najarro, Luis Paz-Ares, Luis Fernández, Nila Castelló, Luis Alberto Richart López, Juan Diego Rodríguez Gambarte, Máximo Sanz García, Ana Salinas, Rocío Suárez, Beatriz Romero-Romero, José Martín-Juan, María Eugenia Viñuela, Ray G Butler, Nuria de Ped
pmc-11696659.description: BackgroundThe objective of this study was to evaluate the use of telomere length measurements as diagnostic biomarkers during early screening for lung cancer in high-risk patients.MethodsThis was a prospective study of patients undergoing lung cancer diagnosis at two Spanish hospitals between April 2017 and January 2020.

pmc-11709494.title: Association of Neuropsychiatric Symptoms and General Psychopathology with Markers of Neurodegeneration in the General Population
pmc-11709494.creator: Rika Etteldorf, Folgerdiena M de Vries, Ulrich Ettinger, Monique MB Breteler
pmc-11709494.description: BackgroundMental disorders have been linked to an increased risk of developing dementia including Alzheimer’s disease. However, previous studies have typically focused on individuals who meet diagnostic criteria for a given psychiatric disorder. The goal of our study was to examine whether diverse neuropsychiatric symptoms are related to early markers of neurodegeneration in the general population.

pmc-11769896.title: Making sense of the literature on antipsychotics and long-term functioning: taking natural history and personalization seriously
pmc-11769896.creator: Awais Aftab
pmc-11769896.description: This review examines the relationship between long-term antipsychotic use and individual functioning, emphasizing clinical implications and the need for personalized care. The initial impression that antipsychotic medications may worsen long-term outcomes is critically assessed, highlighting the confounding effects of illness trajectory and individual patient characteristics.

pmc-12771168.title: Exploring the role of the gut microbiome in pediatric gastrointestinal and neurological health
pmc-12771168.creator: Chaohong Zhang, Guobin Lin, Xiaofei Lu, Xi Yu
pmc-12771168.description: The gut microbiome, a complex ecosystem of microorganisms that inhabit the gastrointestinal (GI) tract, is now understood to be a central regulator of pediatric health and development. This review discusses its centrality in GI and neurological outcomes, with a particular focus on the devastating effects of malnutrition.

pmc-12790860.title: Simplified Assessment of Erectile Dysfunction in Adult Men With Sickle Cell Disease: A Cross-Sectional Validation Study
pmc-12790860.creator: Lucas Neves de Oliveira, Jair Bomfim Santos, Anna Paloma Martins Rocha Ribeiro, Caroline Silva, Ricardo Brianezi Tiraboschi, Jose Bessa Junior
pmc-12790860.description: Objective: To estimate the prevalence of erectile dysfunction (ED) and assess the diagnostic performance of simplified tools - the Erection Hardness Score (EHS), the Massachusetts Male Aging Study (MMAS) single-item scale, and a visual analog “Erectometer” - against the International Index of Erectile Function-5 (IIEF-5) among adult men with sickle cell disease (SCD).

pmc-13145689.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A762 MEASURING ACCESS TO STROKE REPERFUSION TREATMENT IN ITALY USING MAPSTROKE
pmc-13145689.creator: Ettore Nicolini, Antonio Ciacciarelli, Enrica Franchini, Leonardo Dorneles, Mateus Boiani, Marcio Dorn, Santalucia Paola, Valeria Caso, Danilo Toni, Leonardo Carbonera
pmc-13145689.description: Background and aimsTimely access to acute stroke reperfusion therapies depends on geographic proximity to capable hospitals and remains heterogeneous across regions. We applied MAPSTROKE to quantify Italy’s regional/national access to reperfusion-capable hospitals and to identify targeted facility upgrades to reach a ≥90% access benchmark.MethodsUsing MAPSTROKE geospatial modelling, 2023 stroke incidence and population were mapped on a fine hexagonal grid.

pmc-13206577.title: Patient Experience of Emergency Laparotomy: A Mixed Methods Study (The PEEL‐2 Study)
pmc-13206577.creator: Louise M Silva, Sarah A Mohammed, Paula J Strong, Alina Dietrich, Tessa Watts, Jonathan Bisson, Jared Torkington, Julie A Cornish
pmc-13206577.description: BackgroundEmergency laparotomy (EmLap) is a high‐risk surgery for acute abdominal conditions. This study uses a retrospective mixed‐methods approach to explore quality of life and patient‐reported outcomes and experiences (PROMs and PREMs) among EmLap survivors.MethodsPatients who underwent EmLap from 2016–2019 at a tertiary hospital were surveyed, with demographic and clinical data collected from institutional National Emergency Laparotomy Audit (NELA) databases.

pmc-13229699.title: Association between different drinks consumption and risk of inflammatory bowel disease: a dose–response meta–analysis
pmc-13229699.creator: Yu Jie Peng, Yu Zeng, Ding Niu Li, Ke Xi Wei, Min Li
pmc-13229699.description: ObjectiveTo systematically review and synthesize the evidence between consumption of different drinks in daily life and the risk of Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD).MethodsWe systematically searched PubMed, Web of Science, SinoMed, Cochrane Library, Embase, Wiley, CNKI, and Wanfang Database for case–control, cohort, and cross-sectional studies investigating the relationship between beverage intake and IBD. A random-effects model was used for the meta-analysis.

pmc-13355431.title: Biomimetic M2 exosome-based dual-drug nanoplatform for combined immunomodulation and bone protection in rheumatoid arthritis
pmc-13355431.creator: Qing Xu, Yuan Jiang, Yi Luo, Lu Li, Bin Jiang, Cong Ren, Xiaofeng Liu, Runtong Liu, La Zhang, HongQing Liu, Yafang Chai, Yue Li, Ning Jiang, Jianwei Wang
pmc-13355431.description: The current treatment of rheumatoid arthritis (RA) remains limited by severe drug-associated side effects and poor suppression of bone erosion. Herein, we report the development of biomimetic nanoparticles (CEC NPs) that co-deliver celecoxib (CXB) and the lysine-specific demethylase 1 (LSD1) inhibitor CC-90011 via M2 macrophage-derived exosomes (M2 Exos), thereby integrating targeted delivery with innovative multi-mechanistic therapeutic strategies.
